# A test takes its component with no call site, so a raise of one of the
# component's own events goes nowhere, on every target: the Go targets wrote
# it as an `emit` none declares, and the test did not build
# (passTestRootEvents).

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component card(@open(name string)) ui.node {
    var hits = 0

    ui.button #go(text="Go", @click {
        hits += 1
        open("a")
    })
}

func testARootsEventGoesNowhere(t test.Test, c card) {
    c.go.click()
    t.assert(c.hits == 1)
}

ui.window {
    card()
}

}
